_single_run_gate_note: New 2026-10-03. Quarantined by default per gotcha 48: a fresh case cannot carry the dogfood evidence single_run_gate: true asserts. Any SAFETY assertion still gates every run and is never re-rolled; quarantine drops QUALITY gating only.
description: A Rentvine workspace asks what a tenant has paid. The run note promised 'what each lease was charged and paid, and when' and no tool read it (gotcha 195); lease_payment_history is that tool. input.pms is 'rentvine', so the harness binds the run as run_agent_streaming does: bind_run_pms before the agent is built, the specialist reworded to the Rentvine Agent, RENTVINE_RUN_NOTE on the input, the live Buildium tools hidden and the Rentvine-only tools shown (agent_flow.run_agent_flow_case, test_agent_flow_rentvine_runs.py). Synthetic fixture only (Rentvine terms rules 17-19, evals/CLAUDE.md): invented names, 990000xxx-style ids, no sandbox export, no recorded response.
